h1: The 5 Best Mulching Lawn Mowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Mulching Lawn Mowers 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five mulching lawn mowers, gas and cordless, compared on deck size, drive type, power source and how each handles clippings.
summary: The EGO Power+ LM2134SP-2 is our top pick, a self-propelled cordless mower with selectable mulch, bag and side discharge. The PowerSmart EasyGlide is the gas 3-in-1 for less, and the Greenworks 80V is the cordless value pick. The EGO LM2114 and Greenworks 40V cover simpler push needs.
intro: Mulching is not a button you add to any mower. It depends on a deck shaped to hold clippings under the blade long enough to chop them fine, and a motor with the power to keep that cutting. A weak mower with a mulch plug just leaves clumps on the lawn.

We reviewed six listings and kept five true mulching options, comparing deck size, drive, power source and how many discharge modes each offers. Mode lists, drive types and what lawn owners mention set the order, notour own lawn runs, and prices are buckets. We dropped the manual reel mower, which clips but does not mulch.

products.name: EGO Power+ LM2134SP-2 21-Inch Self-Propelled Cordless Mower
products.verdict: Self-propelled, cordless and switchable between three modes.
products.description:
The EGO LM2134SP-2 is a 21 inch self-propelled mower on a 56V battery platform with selectable mulch, bag and side discharge. It sits in the $500+ bucket.

It ranks first because it is the only pick that combines drive wheels, cordless power and all three discharge options. The cost is the highest of the group.

It suits mid to large lawns where mulching is regular. The caveat is price, which only pays off if you mow often.
cons: Only worth it for frequent mowing
products.idealFor: Mid to large lawns mulched regularly.
products.skipIf: You mow a small patch occasionally.

products.name: PowerSmart EasyGlide 21-Inch Gas Mulch/Bag/Side Discharge Mower
products.verdict: A gas 3-in-1 with a 21 inch steel deck for less.
products.description:
The PowerSmart EasyGlide pairs a 21 inch steel deck with a 144cc overhead-valve four-stroke engine, lets you switch between mulching, bagging and side discharge, and offers six cutting heights. It falls in the $200-500 bucket.

Runner-up placement is because it gives the same three modes as the EGO for far less, but it is a push mower with engine upkeep.

It suits buyers who want mode flexibility on a budget. The caveat is oil, fuel and noise.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers wanting full mode choice.

products.name: Greenworks 80V 21-Inch Self-Propelled Mower
products.verdict: Higher voltage for mulching thicker grass.
products.description:
The Greenworks 80V is a 21 inch self-propelled mower with an 80V 4Ah battery and a multi-mode cutting deck. It lands in the $200-500 bucket.

It ranks third because the listing is less specific about modes than the EGO, though the 80V platform gives more headroom in thick grass.

It suits lawns that grow fast and need power for mulching. The caveat is a 4Ah battery that limits large yards.
products.skipIf: Your yard is over half an acre.

products.name: EGO Power+ LM2114 21-Inch Cordless Mower
products.verdict: A push cordless mower with a mulching mode.
products.description:
The EGO LM2114 is a 21 inch cordless push mower on the 56V platform with a battery and charger included and a mulching mode. It sits in the $200-500 bucket.

Fourth place is explained by dropping the drive saves cost over the LM2134SP-2, but you push all of the weight.

It suits standard lawns on flat ground. The caveat is that hills and long sessions tire you out.
products.skipIf: Your lawn slopes or is large.

products.name: Greenworks 40V 16-Inch Push Mower
products.verdict: A compact mulcher for small lawns and Greenworks 40V owners.
products.description:
The Greenworks 40V is a 16 inch push mower with a 40V 4Ah battery and 160Wh of included energy and mulching capability. It falls in the $200-500 bucket.

It ranks last because the narrow deck means more passes and the price is not low for what it offers. It fits well if you already own Greenworks 40V tools.

It suits small lawns. The caveat is the narrow width on anything larger.
products.idealFor: Small lawns and owners of Greenworks 40V tools.
products.skipIf: Your lawn is mid-size or larger.

whatMatters.detail: A mulch mode blocks the discharge so clippings recut under the deck. Without it, clippings drop in clumps. Look for the word mulch in the listing, not just a general claim.
Mulching needs more power than plain cutting. A bigger engine or a higher-voltage battery helps in thick grass. Compare cc for gas and volts for cordless.
A 21 inch deck is the common standard for a house lawn. Smaller decks suit small yards. Pick by lawn area.
Drive wheels reduce effort, especially with the extra drag of mulching. Push mowers cost less. Check whether the listing says self-propelled.
Mulching works best when you remove only the top third of the blade. Multiple height positions let you do that. Look for the count in the specs.

howToChoose.intro: Lawn size picks the deck and power.

cards.label: Gas
cards.text: Gas gives runtime and a lower upfront price but needs upkeep. The PowerSmart EasyGlide is the gas pick.

cards.label: Cordless
cards.text: Cordless is quiet and starts instantly. The EGO models and both Greenworks fit here.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to cordless unless the lawn is large.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A multi-mode deck that bags or mulches, so leaves can be shredded or collected.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The PowerSmart EasyGlide and EGO LM2134SP-2 both offer mulch, bag and side discharge.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You mow weekly on a large lawn, where the EGO LM2134SP-2 saves effort.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: Your lawn is small, where the Greenworks 40V is enough.

faq.a: No, if the clippings are short and dry. Heavy wet piles can smother grass.
Cutting too much at once. Take only about a third off.

faq.q: Is the EGO worth it over the PowerSmart?
faq.a: If you want cordless and drive. The PowerSmart gives three modes for much less.

faq.q: Do I need to bag too?
faq.a: Occasionally, for tall growth or leaves. Multi-mode decks handle this.

faq.q: How do I maintain the blade?
faq.a: Sharpen it each season, since a dull blade tears grass and mulches poorly.

faq.q: Can a push mower mulch well?
faq.a: Yes on flat ground. A drive helps on larger or sloped yards.

finalTake: The EGO LM2134SP-2 is the best mulching mower here if you can afford it. The PowerSmart EasyGlide is the budget gas answer, and the Greenworks 80V is the cordless value. The EGO LM2114 and Greenworks 40V suit simpler lawns. Match the deck and drive to your yard.
